purpose: Direct captured-reference transfer and native-key diagnostics before pose/contact fitting; no selected replacement or training admission.
clock: Every original 120-Hz capture frame; no clipping/filtering/downsampling. Preserve exact source clock separately from glTF float32 encoded clock.
reference_pose: Explicit ASF zero AMC rotations and root translation; not an observed support pose.
orientation_policy: Same segment as joint origin except LeftHand=lhand and RightHand=rhand; compose wrist-twist and hand articulation while anchoring at wrist origin. No source finger/thumb channels selected. Explicit development mapping requires anatomical review.
target_policy: Unchanged default-node target reference, existing orientation calibration, leg-length root scale, zero world offset and no floor lift. Retain source/target originals and target animation/payload metadata.
verification: Full decoded target mesh at every native encoded key; separate CPU skinning and source-role position/root replay. Between-key geometry remains unverified unless separately evaluated.
